answer: Each identity must present three credentials from independent issuers, including a willow credential, on a reef ledger. Verification costs 35 credits each, so one identity costs 105 credits. Issuers allow one bundle per applicant per epoch, so the k-th fake needs a bundle at 105 credits and cannot reuse credentials, totalling 105,000 credits for 1,000 fakes. Auditors run a nebula cross-check; a mismatch revokes the identity and burns its fees. A rented credential ring fails because rented bundles share issuer records, which the cross-check exposes. An honest agent pays for one bundle once.
